title: InNavi project file
description: A project: one or more buildings with their footprints and, for each, the interior (floors, rooms, doors, connectors) and the doors in its outer wall. Written by ABuildingGenerator::SaveBuildingsToFile, read by LoadBuildingsFromJson; described in docs/design/project-file-format.md.

version.description: The format version that wrote the file: 2 when it holds the map around the campus (contextBuildings, roads), 1 otherwise. A file without it was made before versions and reads as 1; a newer one is read as well as it can be.

scale.description: Centimetres in one unit of the footprints and positions of the file (10 means a footprint unit is 10 cm).

floorHeight.description: The height of one floor in centimetres, for the buildings that do not say their own.

contextBuildings.description: The buildings around the campus (of a map database), shown as blocks on the map and not entered. Written when the project was made from a map database.

roads.description: The roads of a map database, drawn on the ground.

pois.description: Not written or shown any more; a file saved by an earlier build may have it, and it is read past.

buildingType.description: One of the types of the editor (BuildingTypes.h).

highway.description: The road's own kind in the map database (primary, residential, footway ...); the width and colour follow from it.

points.description: The road's line, in footprint units.

poiType.description: The place's own kind in the map database (amenity, shop, leisure, tourism); the marker's colour follows from it.

id.description: Unique in the file; what the rest of the file and the phone app call the building.

offset.description: Where the building stands among the others, in footprint units.

buildingType.description: One of the types of the editor (BuildingTypes.h), as written there (Other too).

firstLevel.description: The level of the lowest floor: 1 is the ground floor, -1 is B1 (there is no level 0, which the editor and the layout validator check). The floors go up from it for floorCount floors. Written only when it is not 1.

floorHeight.description: In centimetres; the file's floorHeight when absent.

footprint.description: The outline, in order; edge i runs from point i to point i + 1 (the last to the first).

level.description: 1 is the ground floor, -1 is B1 (there is no level 0).

name.description: What the floor is called besides its number (a mezzanine, a lobby level). Left out when there is none.

open.description: True for a floor without an outer wall (an open ground floor, a sheltered walkway). Left out when false.

utilities.description: Utility points on this floor (an AED, a bicycle rack, a drop-off point). Left out when there are none.

referenceImage.description: A PNG shown under the 2D drawing of the floor, to trace over. Only a guide: it takes no part in routes, checks or the 3D view. The file is not stored in the project, only its path.

path.description: Full path of the PNG on the computer that made the project.

center.description: Where the middle of the picture lies, in footprint units.

width.description: Footprint units; the height follows the picture's own proportions.

visible.description: False when hidden; left out when shown.

utility.description: A point people may look for that is not a room. Only a marker: routes do not go through it.

type.description: An unknown type reads as other.

name.description: Up to 60 characters; left out when empty.

roomType.description: One of the types of the editor (RoomTypes.h), as written there.

navigationId.description: Stable mobile place identity for newly authored rooms.

closed.description: False for a wall that does not close into a room.

opening.description: A door, window or void in a room's wall.

edgeIndex.description: Which edge of the room's footprint.

offset.description: Distance along the edge to the start of the opening, in world units (centimetres).

inputId.description: Doors: the id of what the door opens from.

connectsTo.description: Doors: the id of what it opens to (a room, or "corridor").

navNode.description: A lift, stairs, escalator or path point; the instances of one connector on its floors share a connectorGroupId.

entrance.description: A door in the building's outer wall: a main door to the outside, or a link door to the building next door.

edge.description: Which edge of the building's footprint.

connectsTo.description: Link doors: the other building's id.
